test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is NOT correct regarding banks of India?

options.text: SBI has the maximum number of branches all over India.
Allahabad Bank is the oldest public sector bank of India.
Mobile ATM was first introduced by ICICI bank.
Reserve Bank of India is private bank of India.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Reserve Bank of India is private bank of India.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is the **central bank of India** whose primary function is to manage and govern the financial system of the country. 
 
• It is a **statutory body established in the year 1935** under the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934.
 
• The central bank regulates the issue and supply of the Indian rupee.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **State Bank of India is an Indian multinational public sector bank **and financial services statutory body headquartered in Mumbai, Maharashtra. SBI is the 43rd largest bank in the world.
 
• **Allahabad Bank was an Indian nationalised bank with its headquarters in Kolkata, India**. Founded in Allahabad in 1865 and nationalized by the government of India in 1969, the bank provided banking and financial services for 155 years .
 
• ICICI Bank, India's largest private sector bank, today announced the launch of “**ATM on Wheels**”, India's first Mobile ATM, in Mumbai. The fully networked mobile ATM will be stationed at specific locations.
